key_concepts: Cell is the basic structural unit of life.
Living organisms are made of cells, tissues, organs, and organ systems.
Tissues are made of cells; organs are made of tissues; organ systems are made of organs.

The excretory system includes the kidneys and eliminates metabolic wastes.
